scripts.build: effect-tsgo patch --typescript && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && esbuild src/plugin.ts src/runner-plugin.ts --bundle --external:@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent --external:@oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent --external:@modelcontextprotocol/client --external:kysely --external:pg --external:undici --external:ws --external:redis --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --outdir=dist/plugins
scripts.check: pnpm run build && pnpm db:generate && tsx src/generated/database/index.ts && tsc --noEmit
scripts.test: : "${COORDINATOR_TEST_POSTGRES_URL:?COORDINATOR_TEST_POSTGRES_URL is required: private admin DSN for disposable PostgreSQL 18}" && pnpm run build && vitest run --configLoader native
scripts.broker: pnpm run build && tsx src/main.ts broker
scripts.runner: pnpm run build && tsx src/main.ts runner
scripts.db:generate: prisma contract emit && prisma-effect-kysely contract --contract src/generated/prisma/contract.json --schema prisma/contract.prisma --output src/generated/database
